name: qa-after-deploy
about: QA after deploy (docs/decisions/2026-10-16-qa-after-deploy.md): jarvis-loop has qa_after_deploy, so land sends it with merged and the item waits in qa awaiting a deploy. The thread says 'Merged; I'll ask for your check once it's deployed' with no buttons, and a reply is not taken. A runner on a build from before the merge reports nothing; restarted on a build that contains the merge, it reports deployed and the thread gets the usual ask with Verified and Reopen; Verified moves it to done. The mobile repo (qa: true) keeps today's ask at merge (scenario 33).

messages.text: #[0-9]+: Merged; I'll ask for your check once it's deployed\. <https://github.com/sandbox/jarvis-loop/pull/101\|sandbox/jarvis-loop#101> merged as `[0-9a-f]{7}`; watching main's CI\.\nNothing to check until a loop build that contains it is running\.
^Not taken: I'll ask for your check once it's deployed \(or `/loop verified [0-9]+`, `/loop reopen [0-9]+ <what is wrong>`\)\.$

#[0-9]+: Deployed — waiting for your check\. <https://github.com/sandbox/jarvis-loop/pull/101\|sandbox/jarvis-loop#101> \(merged as `[0-9a-f]{7}`\) is running in the build `[0-9a-f]{7}`\.\nPress Verified when it works
